## WF01 – Email intake
Gmail Trigger (enable once the Gmail credential is connected) **or** the DEMO webhook `POST /webhook/demo/email`.

1. Normalise to the common message format (signatures / quoted replies removed)
2. `of_register_inbound_message` – idempotent (unique message id), identifies contact & agency, correlates the thread
3. Hands the conversation to **WF06_RFQ_MANAGER** (async)

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Enable after connecting the "Gmail (Offshore Fares)" credential (OAuth). Polls the shared inbox every minute.
